units.locator: Article 14. Prohibitions Related to Municipal Service
units.text: г) representing, without remuneration, the interests of the municipality in the governing bodies and audit commission of an organization of which the municipality is a founder (shareholder, participant), in accordance with municipal legal acts determining the procedure for exercising, on behalf of the municipality, the powers of the organization’s founder or the procedure for managing municipally owned shares (interests in charter capital);
units.label: Subpoint «г» Point 3 Part 1 Art. 14

units.locator: Article 14. Prohibitions Related to Municipal Service
units.text: д) other cases provided for by federal laws;
units.label: Subpoint «д» Point 3 Part 1 Art. 14

units.locator: Article 14. Prohibitions Related to Municipal Service
units.text: 3.1) engaging in entrepreneurial activity personally or through authorized agents;
units.label: Point 3.1 Part 1 Art. 14

units.locator: Article 14. Prohibitions Related to Municipal Service
units.text: 4) acting as an agent or representative in third-party matters before the local self-government body in which they hold a municipal service position or which is directly subordinate or accountable to them, unless otherwise provided by federal laws;
units.label: Point 4 Part 1 Art. 14

units.locator: Article 14. Prohibitions Related to Municipal Service
units.text: 5) receiving rewards from individuals or legal entities in connection with official status or the performance of official duties (gifts, monetary remuneration, loans, services, payment for entertainment, holidays or transport expenses, or other rewards). Gifts received by a municipal servant in connection with protocol events, official business trips or other official events are recognized as municipal property and are transferred by the municipal servant under a transfer record to the local self-government body in which the servant holds a municipal service position, except in cases established by the Civil Code of the Russian Federation. A municipal servant who has surrendered a gift received in connection with a protocol event, official business trip or other official event may purchase it according to the procedure established by normative legal acts of the Russian Federation;
units.label: Point 5 Part 1 Art. 14

units.locator: Article 14. Prohibitions Related to Municipal Service
units.text: 6) undertaking business trips funded by individuals or legal entities, except business trips undertaken on a reciprocal basis by agreement between the local self-government body and local self-government bodies of other municipalities, or with state authorities and local self-government bodies of foreign states or international and foreign nonprofit organizations;
units.label: Point 6 Part 1 Art. 14

units.locator: Article 14. Prohibitions Related to Municipal Service
units.text: 7) using material, technical, financial or other support resources, or other municipal property, for purposes unrelated to the performance of official duties;
units.label: Point 7 Part 1 Art. 14

units.locator: Article 14. Prohibitions Related to Municipal Service
units.text: 8) disclosing, or using for purposes unrelated to municipal service, information classified as confidential under federal laws, or official information, learned in connection with the performance of official duties;
units.label: Point 8 Part 1 Art. 14

units.locator: Article 14. Prohibitions Related to Municipal Service
units.text: 9) making public statements, judgments or assessments, including in the mass media, concerning the activities of the local self-government body and its head, unless this forms part of the servant’s official duties;
units.label: Point 9 Part 1 Art. 14

units.locator: Article 14. Prohibitions Related to Municipal Service
units.text: 10) accepting, without the written permission of the head of the municipality, awards or honorary or special titles (other than academic titles) from foreign states, international organizations, political parties, other public associations or religious associations, if interaction with those organizations or associations forms part of the servant’s official duties;
units.label: Point 10 Part 1 Art. 14

units.locator: Article 14. Prohibitions Related to Municipal Service
units.text: 11) using the advantages of official status for election campaigning or campaigning on referendum issues;
units.label: Point 11 Part 1 Art. 14

units.locator: Article 14. Prohibitions Related to Municipal Service
units.text: 12) using official status in the interests of political parties, religious associations or other public associations, or publicly expressing attitudes toward those associations in the capacity of a municipal servant;
units.label: Point 12 Part 1 Art. 14

units.locator: Article 14. Prohibitions Related to Municipal Service
units.text: 13) establishing structures of political parties, religious associations or other public associations in local self-government bodies or other municipal bodies (except trade unions and veterans’ and other bodies of public initiative), or facilitating the establishment of such structures;
units.label: Point 13 Part 1 Art. 14

units.locator: Article 14. Prohibitions Related to Municipal Service
units.text: 14) ceasing to perform official duties for the purpose of resolving a labor dispute;
units.label: Point 14 Part 1 Art. 14

units.locator: Article 14. Prohibitions Related to Municipal Service
units.text: 15) serving on governing bodies, boards of trustees, supervisory boards or other bodies of foreign nonprofit nongovernmental organizations or their structural subdivisions operating in the Russian Federation, unless otherwise provided by an international treaty of the Russian Federation or the legislation of the Russian Federation;
units.label: Point 15 Part 1 Art. 14

units.locator: Article 14. Prohibitions Related to Municipal Service
units.text: 16) engaging, without the written permission of the employer’s representative (employer), in paid activities financed exclusively by foreign states, international or foreign organizations, foreign citizens or stateless persons, unless otherwise provided by an international treaty of the Russian Federation or the legislation of the Russian Federation.
units.label: Point 16 Part 1 Art. 14

units.locator: Article 14. Prohibitions Related to Municipal Service
units.text: 2. A municipal servant holding the position of head of the local administration under a contract is not entitled to engage in other paid activities, except teaching, scientific and other creative activities. Such teaching, scientific and other creative activities may not be financed exclusively by foreign states, international or foreign organizations, foreign citizens or stateless persons, unless otherwise provided by an international treaty of the Russian Federation or the legislation of the Russian Federation. A municipal servant holding the position of head of the local administration under a contract is not entitled to serve on governing bodies, boards of trustees, supervisory boards or other bodies of foreign nonprofit nongovernmental organizations or their structural subdivisions operating in the Russian Federation, unless otherwise provided by an international treaty of the Russian Federation or the legislation of the Russian Federation.
units.label: Part 2 Art. 14

units.locator: Article 14. Prohibitions Related to Municipal Service
units.text: 2.1. Repealed. — Federal Law No. 329-ФЗ of 21.11.2011.
units.label: Part 2.1 Art. 14

units.locator: Article 14. Prohibitions Related to Municipal Service
units.text: 3. After leaving municipal service, a citizen is not entitled to disclose, or use in the interests of organizations or individuals, confidential or official information learned in connection with the performance of official duties.
units.label: Part 3 Art. 14

units.locator: Article 14. Prohibitions Related to Municipal Service
units.text: 4. A citizen who held a municipal service position included in the list of positions established by normative legal acts of the Russian Federation may not, for two years after leaving municipal service, hold a position in an organization under an employment contract and/or perform work for that organization under a civil-law contract in the cases provided for by federal laws, if certain functions of municipal (administrative) management of that organization formed part of the municipal servant’s official (service) duties, without the consent of the relevant commission on compliance with requirements for the official conduct of municipal servants and resolution of conflicts of interest, given according to the procedure established by normative legal acts of the Russian Federation.
units.label: Part 4 Art. 14

units.locator: Article 14.1. Resolution of Conflicts of Interest in Municipal Service
units.text: Article 14.1. Resolution of Conflicts of Interest in Municipal Service
units.label: Art. 14.1

units.locator: Article 14.1. Resolution of Conflicts of Interest in Municipal Service
units.text: 1. For the purposes of this Federal Law, the concept of ‘conflict of interest’ established by part 1 of Article 10 of Federal Law No. 273-ФЗ of 25 December 2008 ‘On Combating Corruption’ is used.
units.label: Part 1 Art. 14.1

units.locator: Article 14.1. Resolution of Conflicts of Interest in Municipal Service
units.text: 2. For the purposes of this Federal Law, the concept of ‘personal interest’ established by part 2 of Article 10 of Federal Law No. 273-ФЗ of 25 December 2008 ‘On Combating Corruption’ is used.
units.label: Part 2 Art. 14.1

units.locator: Article 14.1. Resolution of Conflicts of Interest in Municipal Service
units.text: 2.1. Prevention or resolution of a conflict of interest may consist of changing the official or service position of a municipal servant who is a party to the conflict, up to suspension from the performance of official (service) duties according to the established procedure, and/or the servant’s renunciation of the benefit that caused the conflict of interest.
units.label: Part 2.1 Art. 14.1

units.locator: Article 14.1. Resolution of Conflicts of Interest in Municipal Service
units.text: 2.2. If ownership of securities (participation interests or shares in the charter (pooled) capitals of organizations) by a person holding a municipal service position leads or may lead to a conflict of interest, that person is obliged to transfer the securities (participation interests or shares in the charter (pooled) capitals of organizations) belonging to them into trust management in accordance with the civil legislation of the Russian Federation.
units.label: Part 2.2 Art. 14.1

units.locator: Article 14.1. Resolution of Conflicts of Interest in Municipal Service
units.text: 2.3. Failure by a municipal servant who is a party to a conflict of interest to take measures to prevent or resolve it constitutes an offense resulting in dismissal from municipal service, except in cases established by federal laws.
units.label: Part 2.3 Art. 14.1

units.locator: Article 14.1. Resolution of Conflicts of Interest in Municipal Service
units.text: 3. An employer’s representative (employer) who becomes aware that a municipal servant has a personal interest that leads or may lead to a conflict of interest is obliged to take measures to prevent or resolve that conflict, up to suspending the servant from the municipal service position held for the period required to resolve the conflict, while retaining the servant’s monetary remuneration throughout the suspension from that position.
units.label: Part 3 Art. 14.1

units.locator: Article 14.1. Resolution of Conflicts of Interest in Municipal Service
units.text: 3.1. Failure by a municipal servant acting as the employer’s representative, who becomes aware that a subordinate municipal servant has a personal interest that leads or may lead to a conflict of interest, to take measures to prevent or resolve that conflict constitutes an offense resulting in the dismissal of the municipal servant acting as the employer’s representative from municipal service, except in cases established by federal laws.
units.label: Part 3.1 Art. 14.1

units.locator: Article 14.1. Resolution of Conflicts of Interest in Municipal Service
units.text: 4. To ensure municipal servants’ compliance with general principles of official conduct and the resolution of conflicts of interest, commissions on compliance with requirements for municipal servants’ official conduct and resolution of conflicts of interest may be established within a local self-government body according to the procedure determined by normative legal acts of the constituent entity of the Russian Federation and a municipal legal act.
units.label: Part 4 Art. 14.1

units.locator: Article 14.2. Requirements for the Official Conduct of a Municipal Servant
units.text: Article 14.2. Requirements for the Official Conduct of a Municipal Servant
units.label: Art. 14.2

units.locator: Article 14.2. Requirements for the Official Conduct of a Municipal Servant
units.text: 1. A municipal servant is obliged to:
units.label: Part 1 Art. 14.2

units.locator: Article 14.2. Requirements for the Official Conduct of a Municipal Servant
units.text: 1) perform official duties conscientiously and with a high level of professionalism;
units.label: Point 1 Part 1 Art. 14.2

units.locator: Article 14.2. Requirements for the Official Conduct of a Municipal Servant
units.text: 2) ensure equal and impartial treatment of all individuals, legal entities and organizations, give no preference to any public or religious associations, professional or social groups, citizens or organizations, and avoid bias toward such associations, groups, organizations and citizens;
units.label: Point 2 Part 1 Art. 14.2

units.locator: Article 14.2. Requirements for the Official Conduct of a Municipal Servant
units.text: 3) refrain from actions influenced by any personal, property-related (financial) or other interests that hinder conscientious performance of official duties;
units.label: Point 3 Part 1 Art. 14.2

units.locator: Article 14.2. Requirements for the Official Conduct of a Municipal Servant
units.text: 4) maintain neutrality so as to exclude the possibility that decisions of political parties, other public or religious associations or other organizations influence their professional official activities;
units.label: Point 4 Part 1 Art. 14.2

units.locator: Article 14.2. Requirements for the Official Conduct of a Municipal Servant
units.text: 5) be courteous in dealings with citizens;
units.label: Point 5 Part 1 Art. 14.2

units.locator: Article 14.2. Requirements for the Official Conduct of a Municipal Servant
units.text: 6) respect the moral customs and traditions of the peoples of the Russian Federation;
units.label: Point 6 Part 1 Art. 14.2

units.locator: Article 14.2. Requirements for the Official Conduct of a Municipal Servant
units.text: 7) take account of the cultural and other characteristics of different ethnic and social groups and religious denominations;
units.label: Point 7 Part 1 Art. 14.2

units.locator: Article 14.2. Requirements for the Official Conduct of a Municipal Servant
units.text: 8) promote interethnic and interfaith harmony;
units.label: Point 8 Part 1 Art. 14.2

units.locator: Article 14.2. Requirements for the Official Conduct of a Municipal Servant
units.text: 9) avoid conflict situations capable of damaging their reputation or the standing of the municipal body.
units.label: Point 9 Part 1 Art. 14.2

units.locator: Article 14.2. Requirements for the Official Conduct of a Municipal Servant
units.text: 2. A municipal servant who is a manager is obliged to prevent cases in which municipal servants are compelled to participate in the activities of political parties or other public or religious associations.
units.label: Part 2 Art. 14.2

units.locator: Article 15. Submission of Information on Income, Expenditure, Property and Property-Related Obligations
units.text: Article 15. Submission of Information on Income, Expenditure, Property and Property-Related Obligations
units.label: Art. 15

units.locator: Article 15. Submission of Information on Income, Expenditure, Property and Property-Related Obligations
units.text: 1. A citizen applying for a municipal service position and a municipal servant shall submit to the employer’s representative (employer) information on income, property and property-related obligations provided for by Federal Law No. 273-ФЗ of 25 December 2008 ‘On Combating Corruption’, in the cases established by that Federal Law. This information shall be submitted according to the procedure, within the time limits and using the form established for the submission by state civil servants of constituent entities of the Russian Federation of information on income, property and property-related obligations provided for by Federal Law No. 273-ФЗ of 25 December 2008 ‘On Combating Corruption’.
units.label: Part 1 Art. 15

units.locator: Article 15. Submission of Information on Income, Expenditure, Property and Property-Related Obligations
units.text: 1.1. A municipal servant holding a municipal service position included in the relevant list is obliged to submit information on expenditure provided for by Federal Law No. 230-ФЗ of 3 December 2012 ‘On Monitoring the Correspondence between Expenditure and Income of Persons Holding State Offices and Other Persons’, according to the procedure and using the form established for the submission of such information by state civil servants of constituent entities of the Russian Federation.
units.label: Part 1.1 Art. 15

units.locator: Article 15. Submission of Information on Income, Expenditure, Property and Property-Related Obligations
units.text: 1.2. Monitoring the correspondence between the expenditure and income of a municipal servant, the servant’s spouse and minor children is carried out according to the procedure provided for by Federal Law No. 273-ФЗ of 25 December 2008 ‘On Combating Corruption’, Federal Law No. 230-ФЗ of 3 December 2012 ‘On Monitoring the Correspondence between Expenditure and Income of Persons Holding State Offices and Other Persons’, normative legal acts of the President of the Russian Federation, laws and other normative legal acts of constituent entities of the Russian Federation, and municipal legal acts.
units.label: Part 1.2 Art. 15

units.locator: Article 15. Submission of Information on Income, Expenditure, Property and Property-Related Obligations
units.text: 2. Information submitted by a municipal servant under this Article is confidential unless federal laws classify it as information constituting state secrets or other secrets protected by federal laws.
units.label: Part 2 Art. 15

units.locator: Article 15. Submission of Information on Income, Expenditure, Property and Property-Related Obligations
units.text: 3. Information submitted by a municipal servant under this Article may not be used to establish or determine the solvency of the municipal servant, the servant’s spouse or minor children, or to collect, directly or indirectly, donations (contributions) to the funds of religious or other public associations, other organizations or individuals.
units.label: Part 3 Art. 15

units.locator: Article 15. Submission of Information on Income, Expenditure, Property and Property-Related Obligations
units.text: 4. Persons responsible for disclosing information submitted by a municipal servant under this Article, or for using it for purposes not provided for by the legislation of the Russian Federation, are liable in accordance with the legislation of the Russian Federation.
units.label: Part 4 Art. 15

units.locator: Article 15. Submission of Information on Income, Expenditure, Property and Property-Related Obligations
units.text: 5. Failure by a municipal servant to submit information on income, property and property-related obligations provided for by Federal Law No. 273-ФЗ of 25 December 2008 ‘On Combating Corruption’ and information on expenditure provided for by Federal Law No. 230-ФЗ of 3 December 2012 ‘On Monitoring the Correspondence between Expenditure and Income of Persons Holding State Offices and Other Persons’, where submission is mandatory, or the submission of knowingly incomplete information, constitutes an offense resulting in dismissal from municipal service, except in cases established by federal laws.
units.label: Part 5 Art. 15

units.locator: Article 15. Submission of Information on Income, Expenditure, Property and Property-Related Obligations
units.text: 5.1. A municipal servant’s submission of knowingly inaccurate information specified in part 5 of this Article constitutes an offense resulting in dismissal from municipal service.
units.label: Part 5.1 Art. 15

units.locator: Article 15. Submission of Information on Income, Expenditure, Property and Property-Related Obligations
units.text: 6. Verification of the accuracy and completeness of information on income, property and property-related obligations submitted by citizens applying for municipal service positions included in the relevant list; of the accuracy and completeness of information on income, expenditure, property and property-related obligations submitted by municipal servants holding those positions; of the accuracy and completeness of information submitted by citizens upon entry into municipal service in accordance with normative legal acts of the Russian Federation; and of municipal servants’ observance of restrictions, prohibitions and requirements to prevent or resolve conflicts of interest and their fulfillment of duties established by Federal Law No. 273-ФЗ of 25 December 2008 ‘On Combating Corruption’ and other normative legal acts of the Russian Federation is carried out according to the procedure determined by normative legal acts of the constituent entity of the Russian Federation.
units.label: Part 6 Art. 15

units.locator: Article 15. Submission of Information on Income, Expenditure, Property and Property-Related Obligations
units.text: 7. Requests for information constituting banking, tax or other legally protected secrets, and requests to law enforcement bodies to carry out operational-search measures concerning citizens applying for municipal service positions included in the relevant list, municipal servants holding those positions, and the spouses and minor children of such citizens and municipal servants, are sent in the interests of municipal bodies by the highest officials of constituent entities of the Russian Federation according to the procedure determined by normative legal acts of the Russian Federation.
units.label: Part 7 Art. 15

units.locator: Article 15. Submission of Information on Income, Expenditure, Property and Property-Related Obligations
units.text: 8. Citizens applying to become head of the local administration under a contract shall submit the information specified in part 1 of this Article, and a person holding that position shall submit the information specified in parts 1 and 1.1 of this Article, to the highest official of the constituent entity of the Russian Federation according to the procedure established by a law of that constituent entity.
units.label: Part 8 Art. 15

units.locator: Article 15. Submission of Information on Income, Expenditure, Property and Property-Related Obligations
units.text: 9. Repealed with effect from 1 January 2026. — Federal Law No. 505-ФЗ of 28.12.2025.
units.label: Part 9 Art. 15

units.locator: Article 15. Submission of Information on Income, Expenditure, Property and Property-Related Obligations
units.text: 10. Verification of the accuracy and completeness of information on income, expenditure, property and property-related obligations submitted under part 8 of this Article is carried out by decision of the highest official of the constituent entity of the Russian Federation according to the procedure established by a law of that constituent entity.
units.label: Part 10 Art. 15

units.locator: Article 15. Submission of Information on Income, Expenditure, Property and Property-Related Obligations
units.text: 11. If a verification carried out under part 10 of this Article establishes that a person holding the position of head of the local administration under a contract has failed to observe restrictions or prohibitions or to fulfill duties established by this Federal Law, Federal Law No. 230-ФЗ of 3 December 2012 ‘On Monitoring the Correspondence between Expenditure and Income of Persons Holding State Offices and Other Persons’, or Federal Law No. 79-ФЗ of 7 May 2013 ‘On Prohibiting Certain Categories of Persons from Opening and Holding Accounts (Deposits), Keeping Cash and Valuables in Foreign Banks Located Outside the Territory of the Russian Federation, and Owning and/or Using Foreign Financial Instruments’, the highest official of the constituent entity of the Russian Federation shall apply to the local self-government body authorized to take the relevant decision, or to a court, for early termination of the powers of the person holding the position of head of the local administration under a contract or for the imposition of another disciplinary penalty on that person.
units.label: Part 11 Art. 15

units.locator: Article 15.1. Submission of Information on the Posting of Information on the Internet Information and Telecommunications Network
units.text: Article 15.1. Submission of Information on the Posting of Information on the Internet Information and Telecommunications Network
units.label: Art. 15.1

units.locator: Article 15.1. Submission of Information on the Posting of Information on the Internet Information and Telecommunications Network
units.text: 1. Information on the addresses of websites and/or web pages on the Internet information and telecommunications network on which a citizen applying for a municipal service position or a municipal servant has posted publicly accessible information, as well as data enabling their identification, shall be submitted to the employer’s representative by:
units.label: Part 1 Art. 15.1

units.locator: Article 15.1. Submission of Information on the Posting of Information on the Internet Information and Telecommunications Network
units.text: 1) a citizen applying for a municipal service position, upon entry into service, for the three calendar years preceding the year of entry into municipal service;
units.label: Point 1 Part 1 Art. 15.1

units.locator: Article 15.1. Submission of Information on the Posting of Information on the Internet Information and Telecommunications Network
units.text: 2) a municipal servant, annually for the calendar year preceding the year in which the information is submitted, except where publicly accessible information was posted in the performance of the municipal servant’s official duties.
units.label: Point 2 Part 1 Art. 15.1

units.locator: Article 15.1. Submission of Information on the Posting of Information on the Internet Information and Telecommunications Network
units.text: 2. The information specified in part 1 of this Article is submitted by citizens applying for a municipal service position upon entry into municipal service, and by municipal servants no later than 1 April of the year following the reporting year. The information specified in part 1 of this Article is submitted using the form established by the Government of the Russian Federation.
units.label: Part 2 Art. 15.1

units.locator: Article 15.1. Submission of Information on the Posting of Information on the Internet Information and Telecommunications Network
units.text: 3. By decision of the employer’s representative, municipal servants authorized by that representative shall process publicly accessible information posted on the Internet information and telecommunications network by applicants for municipal service positions and municipal servants, and verify the accuracy and completeness of the information provided for by part 1 of this Article.
units.label: Part 3 Art. 15.1

units.locator: Article 15.2. Submission of a Questionnaire, Reporting Changes to Information Contained in the Questionnaire, and Verification of That Information
units.text: Article 15.2. Submission of a Questionnaire, Reporting Changes to Information Contained in the Questionnaire, and Verification of That Information
units.label: Art. 15.2

units.locator: Article 15.2. Submission of a Questionnaire, Reporting Changes to Information Contained in the Questionnaire, and Verification of That Information
units.text: 1. A citizen shall submit a questionnaire upon entry into municipal service.
units.label: Part 1 Art. 15.2
